rationale: All deterministic functional and art checks pass. The import validates every row before reading or writing task changes, rejects missing titles and unsupported status values, defaults blank status to pending, assigns sequential IDs after the current maximum, and emits stable JSON and text summaries. Tests cover successful import, rollback, case-sensitive status validation, missing columns, banner behavior, and help. The implementation is clear and appropriately uses existing storage/output helpers, though the substantial command logic remains inline rather than factored into focused helpers. The banner is a coherent framed panel with prominent TASKFORGE IMPORT text and useful import concepts; its hierarchy and alignment are strong, if more informational than pictorial. The diff is focused on the command, asset, help, and fixture-owned tests.
